narr: A cold front brought showers and thunderstorms across the region which resulted in severe weather and flash flooding. The backbuilding nature of the storms resulted in localized flash flooding in Hillsborough County. Add detail for svr....
ev: A thunderstorm with torrential rain brought flash flooding to urban areas in southern Nashua. Unofficial weather stations in the area reported instantaneous rainfall rates between 3 and 4 inches per hour, with rainfall totals between 1.75 and 2.25 inches. The rapid runoff overflowed storm water drainage systems which had limited capacity from earlier rainfall. Water up to 2 feet deep was reported on Daniel Webster Highway.
